summary: Shows the documented bonding continuity across the assigned moving gate structure.
description: Shows the documented bonding continuity across the assigned moving gate structure. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Gate and fixed fence structure” at the input and “Gate bonding connection” at the output. Mechanical movement requires a suitable bonding arrangement.
